# entity

In [EhOsContract.Domain](domain-dsl.md), section `domain`.

```elixir
entity name, label
```

A thing with an identity whose lifecycle the application's code or another system keeps, outside this log: a period, an item of a catalogue. Contracts point at it by its identity, a field `{:id, entity}`.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="domain-entity-name"></a>`name` | `atom` | yes |  | The entity's name. |
| <a id="domain-entity-label"></a>`label` | `String.t` | yes |  | What the business calls it. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="domain-entity-context"></a>`context` | `atom` | yes |  | The context that owns it. |
| <a id="domain-entity-identity"></a>`identity` | `atom` | yes |  | The field that identifies it; injected into its fields as a required, non-personal `:id`. |
| <a id="domain-entity-issued_by"></a>`issued_by` | `atom` |  |  | The external of this domain that gives its identity. |
| <a id="domain-entity-source"></a>`source` | `String.t` |  |  | Where the entity comes from in the material. |

Inside it: [`field`](#domain-entity-field).
